name: card-art-generator
description: Pipeline that turns a set theme + producer notes into 3-5 variants of a 10-card collectible set (Claude Code skill; Gemini/OpenAI image backends; per-stage model switching).

scripts.demo: node scripts/validate.mjs examples/summer_fishing.plan.json && node backends/gemini.mjs --plan examples/summer_fishing.plan.json --dry-run && node backends/openai.mjs --plan examples/summer_fishing.plan.json --dry-run && node backends/manual.mjs --plan examples/summer_fishing.plan.json
